about: Failures the report counts as known, not new (docs/testing.md#test-results). Each: the group, a regular expression a FAIL line or the test's name matches, and why. A known failure that passes again is reported, so its entry can go.

known.why: The basics are a map of what isn't built yet; most fail on purpose. Their count of checks passed is compared instead.

known.match: it covers the whole screen, with nothing of the shell or Android's bars on it
known.why: Android 10 keeps its bars over a page in full screen.
